title: Expose a conditional collateral frontier instead of ranking all actuators by one fraction
statement: For the tested incoherent0.8angstrom point functional,the oblique route beats the on-axis parked reference in weighted collateral exactly when1.068wS+1.661wBr<5.132,with other-Cr weight1. body: These are incoming-site fluence diagnostics,not acquired displacement hazards,retained writing,all-species damage advantage or reset. FWHM alone does not determine the mutual intensity. The on-axis parked comparator gives stronger S/Br protection and larger absolute target intensity in the tested cases. A finite rigid native IAM and chosen surrogate disk do not acquire relaxed-state/thermal transition physics. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
